title: kummerowia stipulacea
intro: Kummerowia stipulacea, commonly known as Japanese clover or creeping thyme, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Kummerowia stipulacea include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
